title: The Dragon Rider
line: A kitten knight rides a dragon into the clouds.
prompt: A slow push-in on a fluffy ginger kitten in battered medieval silver plate armour and a white cape, standing on a misty green hill with a sword. A gigantic dark-grey dragon lands in front of it and lowers its head; the kitten climbs onto its neck and they rise through the clouds.

title: Koi Supra
line: A koi-livery Supra on a wet harbour road at night.
prompt: A pearl-white Toyota Supra A80 with a huge red-and-black ukiyo-e koi and wave livery on a wet harbour road in Osaka at night. Slow tracking shots along the livery and the gold wheels, the car at a petrol station glowing pink and teal, and a young woman with a silver bob smiling into a fisheye lens, making a heart with her hands.

title: The Kitten and the Black Dragon
line: Sunglasses on, a black dragon rising behind.
prompt: A desert parking lot at golden-hour sunset, a locked medium close-up at eye level on a fluffy ginger kitten knight in silver plate armour with a white tabard, a small pink bow and sleek silver wraparound sunglasses. A huge dragon with matte jet-black scales rises behind it, and the kitten doesn't even turn around.

title: Kitten in Sunglasses
line: Desert road, silver armour, white sunglasses.
prompt: A small ginger kitten in silver armour and white wraparound sunglasses poses for the camera on a cracked desert road at sunset, adjusting its glasses with an armoured paw, while a black dragon settles on the asphalt behind it.

title: Lobby Run
line: A glowing case, a glass atrium, everyone chasing.
prompt: Handheld, bright morning light, a lean man in his 40s with short dark curly hair and a cobalt-blue bomber jacket sprints through a sunlit glass-and-concrete office atrium carrying a glowing orange suitcase, colleagues in grey suits chasing him, papers flying.

title: The Kitten Knight jumps
line: A flying kick at a water bottle.
prompt: In a white bathroom a kitten knight in silver armour and a short cape launches a flying kung-fu kick at a plastic water bottle with a blue cap standing on the edge of the counter.

title: The Pizza Run
line: Two raccoons, one cop, a slice of pizza.
prompt: A static ultra-wide fisheye dash-cam view inside a car at night. A real raccoon in a backwards baseball cap drives; a second raccoon in small dark sunglasses and a gold chain sits beside him among pizza boxes. A police officer leans in: "License and registration, please." The driver hands him a warm slice of pizza.

title: Mechs in the Snow
line: Two giant robots fight on the ice.
prompt: A blue-hour polar blizzard around a small research outpost, steel-blue grade with orange floodlight glare. Two original 70-metre robots fight across the ice: a dark charcoal brawler with rounded riot-shield shoulders and a pale, sharp-edged duelist with red lights. Sparks, cracking ice, steam, and soldiers in parkas watching from below.

title: Street Characters
line: Santa, a reaper, a witch: 90s street footage.
prompt: Santa Claus gets a pizza delivery by the trash cans and pays with a wrapped gift, a Grim Reaper runs a find-the-card game on the sidewalk, a witch blasts off on a smoking broom between two police officers, five mummies spray-paint a mural, an alien haggles over a taxi fare.

title: The Kitten Knight
line: A tiny knight in a dim living room.
prompt: A tiny fluffy kitten knight in silver armour stands on its hind legs on a dark rug in a dim, warm living room. A floor-level camera makes short, clean moves around it and ends on a close-up as it looks straight into the lens.

title: The Corgi Knight, close
line: Shot 1 · the eye beside the blade.
prompt: Open on an extreme close-up as the camera pushes in slowly toward a corgi puppy knight's eye beside the vertical blade of its sword, cathedral light in the reflection; then the puppy in silver armour and a red cape kneels in the aisle.

title: The Corgi Knight
line: Shot 2 · down the cathedral aisle.
prompt: A corgi puppy knight in silver armour and a red-and-white cape walks straight toward a low frontal camera down the blue carpet of a vast cathedral, sword raised, rows of armoured knights kneeling on both sides, light pouring through the stained-glass window behind it.

title: The Corgi Knight arrives
line: Shot 3 · the arrival.
prompt: A floor-level camera at the edge of a cathedral carpet with a strong dutch tilt; far down the aisle a tiny corgi knight in silver armour walks toward us between rows of kneeling knights, the stained-glass window blazing behind it.
